entry.title: ARIA 1.3.2
entry.summary: The MPC version of the ARIA VST3: an 8-voice bi-timbral analogue-modelling poly. Two oscillators with wave mix, FM and sync, a mod osc per voice, two ladder filters (series, stereo or parallel), looping envelopes, a chord memory with a chord on every key, an arp with a 16-step pattern, a low split and a diffusion delay. Panel-style touch pages.
